mission: Implement important remaining functional gaps after reading the comprehensive plan and Beads; checkpoint meaningful changes directly to main through GitHub, without PRs.

authority.repository: Explicit user authorization for direct main commits with GitHub; no PR.
authority.operational: Repository work only. No live devices, policies, recordings, alerts or user evidence were changed.

findings: Broad open Beads already contain substantial implementations, so priorities were chosen from actual remaining source paths.
Video and dwell read/verification plus original-media preparation still acquired the exclusive deployment writer and could enter recovery.
Concurrent main strengthened canonical witness custody; reviewed-media and dwell metadata reservations must count those exact witness reads.

delivered.feature: Immutable retained-dwell inspection and native replay
Immutable original-media previews with reviewed event custody

behavior.reader: One root-scoped sealed immutable source from opening metadata through final payload/publication/journal validation.
behavior.delivery: Complete report buffered until final validation; video file creation begins afterward through the existing protected create-new path.
behavior.concurrency: The writer can remain held under stable authority. Any authority advance invalidates the snapshot and requires a fresh request.
behavior.missing_history: Missing or torn effect journals refuse without initialization, repair or recovery.
behavior.mutation: Approved original-media export and video publication remain exclusive.
behavior.identity: Existing producer and media-export canonical identities are preserved. Video read/verify approvals additionally bind aggregate limits and immutable-read policy; publication approval encoding is unchanged.
behavior.native_replay: Dwell keeps exact recipe/pins, current privacy and whole trace/classifier/event matching. Video drains and verifies the whole original range.
behavior.reviewed_lineage_budget: After initial history/review-statement reads, reserve 3H+2W, where H is all canonical event manifest/payload bytes and W is all distinct canonical witness bytes.

limits.deadline_scope: Cooperative read admissions and final delivery, not preemptive interruption of filesystem operations or compute kernels.

validation.source_review: All three production slices independently reviewed. Corrected missing-effects history acceptance in dwell and updated shared reviewed-lineage reservations after concurrent witness hardening.
validation.formatting: Scoped pinned rustfmt completed on final changed Rust sources. Whitespace and conflict-marker checks passed on changed/new Rust files.
validation.metadata: Repository cargo metadata --locked --offline passed and all six focused integration targets were registered. Supplemental scratch harness resolves 199 dependencies with identical repository versions, sources and checksums; it is not a qualification entry point.
compiler_attempts: Initial serial library check was interrupted after host stalls.
Second serial check lost its executor; no terminal outcome or source diagnostic was recovered.
Final protected serial check ended with Cargo SIGKILL before edited FSS crates.

final_check.command: cargo check --locked --offline -p fss-reference --lib -p fss-cli --bin fss-replay-dwell --bin fss-export --bin fss-video
final_check.profile: One Cargo job; dev/test debug info disabled; incremental disabled; exact pinned locked offline dependencies.

validation.integrity: Source snapshots preserved through GitHub trees before publication; changed-file SHA-256 overlay rows updated. Final remote and worktree integrity checks recorded separately in session output.
validation.qualification: No verified typecheck, runtime test pass, full-workspace, real-device, detection-quality or release qualification. No dependency, toolchain or acceptance-gate changes.

retry_commands: cargo check --locked --offline -j1 -p fss-reference --lib -p fss-cli --bin fss-replay-dwell --bin fss-export --bin fss-video

continuations.work: Execute the focused Rust contracts on a functioning host, retaining exact pinned dependencies and release gates.
The existing plan still calls for request-owned MCP execution/cancellation so long native calls do not block cancellation input; use the existing structured runtime and explicit authority.
Standing indefinite recorder authority remains gated by the recorded D7 decision; no new standing capture authority is introduced here.

obligations: Three meaningful feature checkpoints directly on main; no PRs.
Broad Beads remain open until their registered acceptance evidence exists.
